Rin: Heads-up: billing discrepancy spike for web-sdk cohort — ~0.6% token loss observed during 2026-03-22 deploy window. Suspect client-side drop + gateway retry dedupe.

Omar: Any sample event?

Rin: Example envelope:
```json
{"eid":"e-77","tenant":"web-sdk","user":"u314","tokens":22,"ts":"2026-03-22T10:05:00Z","seq":10,"fingerprint":"fp_xyz","prov":"client:v1"}
```
Observed gaps in seq for same fingerprint.

June: Two paths: (1) server estimator that emits provisional compensating credits, (2) force-client-update and ignore small loss. For customer experience I favour provisional estimators with TTL.

Omar: For audits we must append compensating events, never mutate. Also need dedupe and reconciler_run id.

audit-bot: reminder: reconciler emissions require proof entry in compact_proofs (date, tenant, reconciler_run, merkle_root).

Rin: Proposed flow:
- detect via drop alert
- run estimator dry-run -> generate candidate deltas with confidence score
- if approved, emit `recon:est` provisional events with `reconciler_run` and `dedupe_key`
- when logs/backfill present, emit `recon:final` and mark provisional reconciled
- invoices show net only after window W (default 14d)

June: dedupe_key = sha256(tenant|user|day|seq_range|est_ver). Ingestion rejects duplicates.

Omar: storage note: provisional+final doubles events; compact_proofs must point to archived raw events so auditors can verify. Add support ticket flow to resolve cases where final doesn't appear after W.

Rin: I'll land a dry-run job and post the report. Will also add runbook safety: no writes without human approval and `--commit` flag.

June: I'll pick up UI flag for provisional lines and add CS notifications if delta > threshold.

Omar: I'll handle audit-index + migration for compact proofs.

ops-bot: alert: web-sdk drop-rate 0.61% (2026-03-22 10:10 UTC) :warning:
